posts.title: St Helens' Play‑off Hopes Fade After Hull Loss – South Africa Betting Tips
posts.excerpt: St Helens' play‑off chances are shattered after a heavy defeat to Hull FC. South African punters can find value on Hull, player props and over/under markets – plus top local bonuses.
posts.body:
St Helens’ play‑off hopes are effectively over after a 24‑point defeat to Hull FC, and South African punters should adjust their stakes accordingly. The BBC reports that Hull’s Barron hat‑trick sealed a 30‑6 victory, leaving the Saints scrambling for points with only a handful of games left.

## What the Result Means for the Super League Table  

Hull FC’s win lifted them into the top‑six, while St Helens slipped to ninth with 22 points from 14 matches. With just three rounds remaining, the Saints need a win in each of their remaining fixtures and hope other results go their way – a tall order for any side. For South African bettors, the focus shifts from a straight win‑bet on St Helens to value on Hull, total points, and individual player performances.

### Over 44.5 Points  

The match produced 36 points, but both teams have shown a propensity to score heavily in recent weeks. The over 44.5 market is priced just under evens at Hollywoodbets (1.95) and slightly higher at Supabets (2.00). With Hull’s attack clicking and St Helens desperate for points, the over offers good value.

### First Try Scorer – Barron  

Barron’s hat‑trick was the story of the night. South African punters who trust the player‑prop market can back him at roughly 4.20 with Hollywoodbets. The price is marginally shorter at Supabets (4.10) but still attractive given his recent form.
